Children who grow up feeling safe carry a beautiful trait into adulthood. 🌙

Ivy walks down the dark hall at night. Mom lifts the blanket: "You're safe. You're welcome here." And every year, another square gets sewn into her quilt: 🧵
✅ Secure in love. At four, she learns love isn't going anywhere.
✅ Not afraid of feelings. At eight, she's comforted, not shushed.
✅ She asks for help. At ten, she doesn't have to figure it out alone.
✅ She belongs. At fourteen, she knows where home is.
✅ Comfort for life. At sixteen, she carries comfort with her.

At thirty, on a night when worry hits hard, she picks up her phone and calls home. 📱 And years later, her own little girl crawls in under the same quilt. ❤️

"The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms." Deuteronomy 33:27 (ESV) 🙏 God's arms are always wide open, so she always has a safe place to run.

What you give them today, they carry forever. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
